sentences.cn_text: 正如亚历山大·波利亚科夫在今年三月接受这一奖项时所说，这项奖金为300万美元的基础物理学奖的确是一个有趣的实验。
sentences.en_text: The US $3-million Fundamental Physics Prize is indeed an interesting experiment, as Alexander Polyakov said when he accepted this year’s award in March.

sentences.cn_text: 而且它远非此类奖项中的唯一一个。
sentences.en_text: And it is far from the only one of its type.

sentences.cn_text: 正如《自然》杂志一篇新闻特写文章所讨论的，近年来一系列面向研究人员的丰厚奖项已加入诺贝尔奖的行列。
sentences.en_text: As a News Feature article in Nature discusses, a string of lucrative awards for researchers have joined the Nobel Prizes in recent years.

sentences.cn_text: 许多奖项，如基础物理学奖，都由互联网企业家以其天文数字般的银行账户提供资助。
sentences.en_text: Many, like the Fundamental Physics Prize, are funded from the telephone-number-sized bank accounts of Internet entrepreneurs.

sentences.cn_text: 这些捐助者表示，他们在各自选择的领域已获得成功，希望用自己的财富将人们的注意力引向那些在科学领域取得成功的人。
sentences.en_text: These benefactors have succeeded in their chosen fields, they say, and they want to use their wealth to draw attention to those who have succeeded in science.

sentences.cn_text: 有什么不好的呢？
sentences.en_text: What’s not to like?

sentences.cn_text: 据新闻特写中引述的几位科学家所说，问题相当多。
sentences.en_text: Quite a lot, according to a handful of scientists quoted in the News Feature.

sentences.cn_text: 正如古语所云，品位无法用金钱购买，而这些新贵企业家也无法为其奖项买到诺贝尔奖的声望。
sentences.en_text: You cannot buy class, as the old saying goes, and these upstart entrepreneurs cannot buy their prizes the prestige of the Nobels.

sentences.cn_text: 科学家们认为，这些新奖项是幕后人士进行自我宣传的手段。
sentences.en_text: The new awards are an exercise in self-promotion for those behind them, say scientists.

sentences.cn_text: 它们可能扭曲以成就为基础、由同行评审主导的研究体系。
sentences.en_text: They could distort the achievement-based system of peer-review-led research.

sentences.cn_text: 它们可能固化同行评审研究的现状。
sentences.en_text: They could cement the status quo of peer-reviewed research.

sentences.cn_text: 它们不为同行评审研究提供资助。
sentences.en_text: They do not fund peer-reviewed research.

sentences.cn_text: 它们使孤独天才的神话长久延续。
sentences.en_text: They perpetuate the myth of the lone genius.

sentences.cn_text: 颁奖者的目标似乎与批评声一样分散。
sentences.en_text: The goals of the prize-givers seem as scattered as the criticism.

sentences.cn_text: 有人想要制造轰动效应，有人则想吸引人们投身科学，或更好地奖励那些以研究为职业的人。
sentences.en_text: Some want to shock, others to draw people into science, or to better reward those who have made their careers in research.

sentences.cn_text: 正如《自然》此前所指出的，对于科学奖项——无论新旧——的分配方式，存在一些合理的担忧。
sentences.en_text: As Nature has pointed out before, there are some legitimate concerns about how science prizes — both new and old — are distributed.

sentences.cn_text: 今年设立的生命科学突破奖对生命科学范畴的界定缺乏代表性。
sentences.en_text: The Breakthrough Prize in Life Sciences, launched this year, takes an unrepresentative view of what the life sciences include.

sentences.cn_text: 但诺贝尔基金会每项奖励最多三位获奖者且必须在世的限制，早已不能适应现代研究的协作性质——这一点将在关于谁在希格斯玻色子发现的认定中被忽略的不可避免的争论中得到体现。
sentences.en_text: But the Nobel Foundation’s limit of three recipients per prize, each of whom must still be living, has long been outgrown by the collaborative nature of modern research — as will be demonstrated by the inevitable row over who is ignored when it comes to acknowledging the discovery of the Higgs boson.

sentences.cn_text: 当然，诺贝尔奖本身也是由一位极为富有的个人设立的，由他决定如何使用自己的资金。
sentences.en_text: The Nobels were, of course, themselves set up by a very rich individual who had decided what he wanted to do with his own money.

sentences.cn_text: 是时间而非意图赋予了诺贝尔奖合法性。
sentences.en_text: Time, rather than intention, has given them legitimacy.

sentences.cn_text: 尽管一些科学家可能对这些新奖项颇有微词，但有两点似乎是明确的。
sentences.en_text: As much as some scientists may complain about the new awards, two things seem clear.

sentences.cn_text: 首先，大多数研究人员若被授予此类奖项，都会接受。
sentences.en_text: First, most researchers would accept such a prize if they were offered one.

sentences.cn_text: 其次，资金和关注流向科学而非其他领域，这无疑是一件好事。
sentences.en_text: Second, it is surely a good thing that the money and attention come to science rather than go elsewhere.

sentences.cn_text: 批评和质疑这种机制是合理的——毕竟这是研究文化的一部分——但这笔资金归颁奖者所有，他们有权随意支配。
sentences.en_text: It is fair to criticize and question the mechanism — that is the culture of research, after all — but it is the prize-givers’ money to do with as they please.

sentences.cn_text: 明智之举是怀着感激和优雅接受这样的馈赠。
sentences.en_text: It is wise to take such gifts with gratitude and grace.

sentences.cn_text: 它们的持久性证明了其价值。
sentences.en_text: Their endurance has done justice to them.

sentences.cn_text: 它们的合法性长期以来一直受到质疑。
sentences.en_text: Their legitimacy has long been in dispute.

sentences.cn_text: 它们是最具代表性的荣誉。

sentences.cn_text: 历史从未对它们提出质疑。
